reason.uz: Pishloq, zardob va kazein uchun ishlatilgan ferment (hayvon yoki mikrob) ko'rsatilmagan.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Traditional rennet comes from calf stomach; microbial rennet is also common.

rules.title: Check: insect-derived

reason.ko: 곤충 유래 성분(연지벌레 색소, 셸락 등)으로, 허용 여부에 대한 견해가 갈립니다.
reason.en: Insect-derived ingredient (e.g. carmine, shellac); scholarly opinions differ on permissibility.
reason.uz: Hasharotdan olingan tarkib (masalan, karmin, shellak); joizligi haqida olimlar fikri turlicha.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Views differ between and within schools of jurisprudence.

rules.title: Check: possibly animal-derived

reason.ko: 동물에서 유래했을 수 있는 성분입니다(예: 비타민 D3, L-시스테인, 핵산계 조미료). 출처를 확인해야 합니다.
reason.en: May be derived from animals (e.g. vitamin D3, L-cysteine, nucleotide seasonings). The source must be checked.
reason.uz: Hayvondan olingan bo'lishi mumkin (masalan, D3 vitamini, L-sistein, nukleotid ziravorlari). Manbani tekshirish kerak.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Some producers use animal (including hair, feather or fish) sources; alternatives exist.

rules.title: Check: umbrella additive term

reason.ko: 포괄 명칭만 표시되어 실제 물질과 그 출처를 알 수 없습니다. 괄호 안에 세부 원료가 있으면 그 기준으로 판단합니다.
reason.en: Only an umbrella term is listed, so the actual substance and its source are unknown. If bracketed sub-ingredients are given, those decide the result.
reason.uz: Faqat umumiy nom ko'rsatilgan, haqiqiy modda va uning manbasi noma'lum. Qavs ichida aniq tarkib bo'lsa, natija shu asosida chiqariladi.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Umbrella terms such as 유화제 or 산도조절제 cover many substances with different origins.

rules.title: Check: wine vinegar

reason.ko: 와인·발사믹 식초는 포도주에서 만들어지며 허용 여부에 견해 차이가 있습니다.
reason.en: Wine and balsamic vinegar are made from wine; opinions on permissibility differ.
reason.uz: Vino va balzamik sirka sharobdan tayyorlanadi; joizligi haqida fikrlar turlicha.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Most authorities accept vinegar after transformation, some do not for wine-derived vinegar.

rules.title: Check: fermented sauces

reason.ko: 발효 장류·간장은 발효 과정에서 미량의 알코올이 생기거나 주정이 더해질 수 있어 제조 방식 확인이 필요합니다.
reason.en: Fermented soy/pepper sauces and soy sauce may contain naturally formed or added trace alcohol; the production method must be checked.
reason.uz: Fermentatsiyalangan soya/qalampir sousi va soya sousi oz miqdorda tabiiy yoki qo'shilgan spirt saqlashi mumkin; ishlab chiqarish usulini tekshirish kerak.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Brewing produces trace ethanol and some products add 주정 as a preservative.

rules.title: Flagged: pork and pork derivatives

reason.ko: 성분표에서 돼지고기 원료가 확인되었습니다.
reason.en: Pork ingredient detected in the ingredient list.
reason.uz: Tarkib ro'yxatida cho'chqa go'shti aniqlandi.

rules.evidence: Pork and its derivatives are prohibited (Qur'an 2:173, 5:3, 6:145, 16:115).

rules.title: Flagged: blood

reason.ko: 혈액 또는 혈액 유래 원료(선지 등)가 성분표에서 확인되었습니다.
reason.en: Blood or a blood-derived ingredient was detected in the ingredient list.
reason.uz: Tarkib ro'yxatida qon yoki qondan olingan tarkib aniqlandi.

rules.evidence: Flowing blood is prohibited (Qur'an 2:173, 6:145).

rules.title: Flagged: alcoholic beverage as ingredient

reason.ko: 술(와인·맥주·청주·맛술 등)이 원료로 사용되었습니다.
reason.en: An alcoholic beverage (wine, beer, sake, mirin, spirits …) is used as an ingredient.
reason.uz: Alkogolli ichimlik (vino, pivo, sake, mirin va h.k.) tarkib sifatida ishlatilgan.

rules.evidence: Intoxicants are prohibited (Qur'an 5:90-91).

rules.title: Term: pork words

reason.ko: 성분표에서 돼지고기 원료가 확인되었습니다.
reason.en: Pork ingredient detected in the ingredient list.
reason.uz: Tarkib ro'yxatida cho'chqa go'shti aniqlandi.

rules.evidence: Pork and its derivatives are prohibited (Qur'an 2:173, 5:3, 6:145, 16:115). Exceptions (e.g. 돼지감자, bacon flavour) are ingredient-level rules with higher priority.

rules.title: Term: blood words

reason.ko: 성분명에 혈액 관련 표현이 포함되어 있습니다.
reason.en: The ingredient name contains a blood-related word.
reason.uz: Tarkib nomida qonga oid so'z bor.

rules.evidence: Blood is prohibited (Qur'an 2:173, 6:145). 'Blood orange' is an ingredient-level exception.

rules.title: Term: gelatin / collagen words

reason.ko: 제품 정보만으로는 원료의 출처를 확인할 수 없습니다.
reason.en: Ingredient source could not be determined from available product information.
reason.uz: Mavjud mahsulot ma'lumotidan tarkib manbasini aniqlab bo'lmadi.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Gelatin/collagen may come from pork, beef or fish (source animal not stated). Fish-derived gelatin/collagen is an explicit ingredient-level exception.

rules.title: Term: alcohol words

reason.ko: 성분명에 알코올(주정) 관련 표현이 있어 사용 목적과 출처 확인이 필요합니다.
reason.en: The ingredient name mentions alcohol/ethanol; its purpose and origin must be checked.
reason.uz: Tarkib nomida spirt/etanol tilga olingan; maqsadi va manbasi tekshirilishi kerak.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Includes 'alcohol-free' wording on purpose: it is surfaced for a human to confirm.

rules.title: Exception: 돼지감자 (Jerusalem artichoke) is a plant

reason.ko: 돼지감자(뚱딴지)는 이름에 '돼지'가 들어가지만 식물(뿌리채소)입니다.
reason.en: 돼지감자 (Jerusalem artichoke) has 'pig' in its name but is a plant (tuber).
reason.uz: 돼지감자 (yerqo'zoq) nomida 'cho'chqa' bor, lekin o'simlik (ildizmeva).

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Name-based pork term rule intentionally overridden.

rules.title: Exception: blood orange is a fruit

reason.ko: 블러드 오렌지는 과일이며 혈액 성분이 아닙니다.
reason.en: Blood orange is a fruit, not a blood ingredient.
reason.uz: Qonli apelsin meva, qon tarkibi emas.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Name-based blood term rule intentionally overridden.

rules.title: Bacon flavour: source not stated

reason.ko: 베이컨 맛/향은 식물성일 수도, 돼지고기 성분이 들어갈 수도 있어 출처를 확인해야 합니다.
reason.en: Bacon flavour can be plant-based or contain pork; the source must be checked.
reason.uz: Beykon ta'mi/hidi o'simlik asosida bo'lishi yoki cho'chqa tarkibini saqlashi mumkin; manbani tekshirish kerak.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. A flavour name is not proof of pork; also not proof of absence.

rules.title: Exception: fish gelatin (source stated)

reason.ko: 어류에서 얻은 젤라틴으로 출처가 명시되어 있으며, 어류는 할랄 기준에서 허용되는 원료로 널리 인정됩니다.
reason.en: Gelatin whose source is stated as fish; fish is widely accepted as a halal-eligible source.
reason.uz: Manbasi baliq deb ko'rsatilgan jelatin; baliq halol manba sifatida keng tan olingan.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Source is explicit in the ingredient text.

rules.title: Exception: fish collagen (source stated)

reason.ko: 어류에서 얻은 콜라겐으로 출처가 명시되어 있습니다.
reason.en: Collagen whose source is stated as fish.
reason.uz: Manbasi baliq deb ko'rsatilgan kollagen.

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar. Source is explicit in the ingredient text.

rules.title: Pork gelatin is flagged

reason.ko: 돼지 유래 젤라틴/콜라겐으로 표시되어 있습니다.
reason.en: The gelatin/collagen is stated to be pork-derived.
reason.uz: Jelatin/kollagen cho'chqadan olingani ko'rsatilgan.

rules.evidence: Pork and its derivatives are prohibited (Qur'an 2:173, 5:3, 6:145, 16:115).

rules.title: 돈가스소스 is a sauce, not pork

reason.ko: 소스류는 여러 원료의 혼합물이라 세부 원료 확인이 필요합니다(돈가스 소스는 돼지고기가 아닙니다).
reason.en: Composite sauce: its own ingredients must be checked (tonkatsu sauce is not pork).
reason.uz: Murakkab sous: uning tarkibini tekshirish kerak (tonkatsu sousi cho'chqa go'shti emas).

rules.evidence: HalalMap editorial screening rule (conservative). Not a fatwa or certification; consult your certifier or scholar.
